title: Observer Ascends the Throne · Finale
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji ascended alone to the highest point of the imperial capital, the golden characters on the final page of the Tianji Record slowly revealed themselves—that was the beginning of the twenty-five day countdown, and also the prelude to the ultimate showdown between the Observer and him.

text.content:
Dawn had barely broken, yet the smoke over the Golden Phoenix Hall had not yet dispersed.

Chen Ji stood before the white jade steps, gazing at the ruined capital, yet his heart was unexpectedly calm. On the streets, the common people had already begun clearing the rubble on their own, rebuilding their homes. Some wept, some laughed, but most silently carried broken bricks and shattered tiles.

Was this the new order he sought? The Observer's rules—survival of the fittest, heaven's way without mercy. Yet what he witnessed now was the glimmer of hope in the eyes of those who had survived the catastrophe.

"My lord, Han Lie of the Tianqing Sect requests an audience." The attendant's voice broke Chen Ji's contemplation.

A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips. Han Lie—that Xuanwu Sect's number one genius who had been repeatedly crushed by him yet grew stronger with each defeat—had finally come seeking an audience at this moment. He was curious to see what arguments this "sworn enemy" had prepared this time.

"Let him in."

dialogue.content:
Han Lie strode into the hall, his killing aura still undispersed, yet his gaze held an unexpected complexity. He knelt on one knee, voice hoarse: "Observer, Chen Ji—no, what should I call you? Master of the Tianji Record?"

Chen Ji looked down at this former nemesis with composure: "What do you want to say?"

Han Lie abruptly raised his head, humiliation and defiance flickering in his eyes: "Twenty-five years! I've chased you for twenty-five years! Every time I thought I could finally crush you, you—you always managed a stunning reversal!"

text.content:
Han Lie's words struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. Twenty-five years of pursuit—back when he was just a talented youth who knew only brute force, Han Lie had now grown into an existence capable of standing against the Observer.

"You came today to end this?" Chen Ji asked.

Han Lie shook his head, rising to his feet, and a trace of a smile actually appeared in his eyes: "No, I've come to tell you something—Lin Yuan has joined forces with the remnants of the dimensional invaders. The Heavenly Fate Guardians Alliance is officially a rebel army from this day forward."

choice.prompt: Han Lie's intelligence is crucial—how will you respond?

choices.description: A former nemesis now proactively extends an olive branch—perhaps this is the perfect opportunity to turn an enemy into an ally.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the combat power support of Xuanwu Sect's number one genius
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie's loyalty remains doubtful—he may turn against you at a critical moment

text.content: A flash of surprise flickered in Han Lie's eyes, then transformed into determination. He extended his calloused palm, clasping Chen Ji's hand. "Excellent! From this day forward, Han Lie's fist shall be your backing!"

choices.description: A sworn enemy is still a sworn enemy—twenty-five years of grudges cannot be erased with a single statement.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain strategic autonomy, free from entanglement
choices.risk_hint: Will face more enemies alone in the final battle

text.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly: "I accept your intelligence. As for the alliance—" He paused, "Prove your sincerity in the final battle first." Han Lie's expression turned grim, yet he cupped his fists and departed.

choices.description: A sworn enemy suddenly showing goodwill must have hidden motives. Let's feel out the details first.

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly: "Han Lie, we've fought each other for twenty-five years. When did you learn to extend olive branches? Speak—what do you really want?" Han Lie's expression shifted, then burst into laughter: "As expected, I can't hide it from you! I want to know—where is Chen Nian?"

The name Chen Nian was like a blade, piercing directly into the softest corner of Chen Ji's heart. His pupils contracted sharply, yet his expression remained calm: "Why are you asking about her?"

Han Lie drew a deep breath, complex emotions surfacing in his eyes: "Because Lin Yuan has captured her. She is—the Heavenly Fate Lock-Key."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji abruptly rose, a surge of boundless fury erupting from his body. The air in the Golden Phoenix Hall instantly froze, and cracks began spreading across the floor.

"Say it again." His voice was dangerously low.

Han Lie showed no retreat: "Lin Yuan has collaborated with the dimensional invaders. They need an 'anchor' to stabilize the dimensional rift. Chen Nian—your sister—is that anchor."

text.content:
Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the churning emotions. Remembering grudges without acting rashly—this was his greatest strength. Lin Yuan, you dare touch Chen Nian—this debt, he would remember.

"Twenty-five years." Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice regaining calm, "You chased me for twenty-five years, never once winning. But this time—" He raised his head, a fierce gleam flashing in his eyes, "I won't disappoint you either."

Han Lie was momentarily stunned, then revealed a relieved smile. He turned to leave, pausing at the door: "Chen Ji, victory or defeat between us will be decided in this final battle."

The palace doors closed, Chen Ji stood alone in the vast hall. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: "Master, Chen Nian is indeed in Lin Yuan's hands. Are you—prepared?"

choice.prompt: Chen Nian has been captured by Lin Yuan—you must make a decision.

choices.description: His sister was his greatest weakness—even if it disrupted all his plans, he had to save her.
choices.visible_reward: Rescue Chen Nian and resolve the heartache
choices.risk_hint: May fall right into Lin Yuan's trap

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly rose, determination flashing in his eyes: "Prepare the horses! I will go personally—" Before he finished, a familiar voice came from outside the hall: "Wait!" Su Qingyao, in her martial attire, strode in.

choices.text: Proceed with the original battle plan
choices.description: The greater good comes first. The prerequisite for rescuing Chen Nian is first ending this chaotic world.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian will endure more suffering
choices.visible_reward: Maintain strategic advantage and lay foundations for final victory
choices.risk_hint: May be used by Lin Yuan as leverage

text.content: Chen Ji slowly sat back down, his fists clenching tightly. "Tell Lin Yuan," his voice was ice-cold, "In twenty-five days, I will personally go to retrieve her. At that time, I will make him regret today's choice."

choices.text: Pursue both lines simultaneously, secretly maneuver
choices.description: Neither abandon Chen Nian nor disrupt the battle plan. Use the Tianji Record to find an optimal solution for both.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Find the optimal solution for rescue and the final battle
choices.risk_hint: Excessive Heavenly Fate consumption may affect the final battle

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, the Tianji Record fragments unfurling in his mind. A blurry image emerged—Chen Nian imprisoned somewhere, yet that place was in the same mountain range as the final battlefield.

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao walked before Chen Ji, handing over a secret letter: "I've investigated Lin Yuan's movements. He has occupied the main peak of the Heavenly Secrets Mountains, which is precisely where the dimensional rift is most unstable."

Her gaze fell on Chen Ji's face, her voice unusually gentle: "Whatever decision you make, I will stand by your side."

text.content:
Chen Ji took the secret letter, his gaze complex as he looked at Su Qingyao. This Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect, who had countless times attempted to uncover his true identity, had now become his most steadfast guardian.

Shared Fate—that special buff unlocked at full affection—was now faintly radiating a warm glow.

dialogue.content:
Outside the hall, a black figure descended gracefully. Ye Qing, the Demonic Path Saintess, in black robes that accentuated her graceful curves, yet her expression carried unprecedented solemnity.

"Observer," her voice was cold and clear, "The remnants of the dimensional invaders have completely merged with Lin Yuan. They are activating the ancient altar deep in the Heavenly Secrets Mountains—this is a scheme to swallow the entire capital into the dimension."

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes in contemplation. All the clues, at this moment, connected together. The Turtle Shell artifact pointing to the Heavenly Secrets Mountains, the benefactor's method for bloodline awakening, the bond between twin fates—all pointed to the same location.

He abruptly opened his eyes: "Transmit my order—in three days, the court assembly will announce the final battle date. I want the entire world to know in what manner the Observer's new order will descend."

choice.prompt: The final battle date is set—you must choose how to face these last twenty-five days.

choices.description: As the Observer, face this fateful battle with dignity and honor.
choices.visible_reward: Greatly increase reputation, win the hearts of the people

text.content: Su Qingyao and Ye Qing exchanged glances, then simultaneously cupped their fists: "Willing to follow the Observer through fire and water!" Chen Ji looked at these two women of vastly different personalities, and warmth surged in his heart.

choices.description: Utilize the power of the Tianji Record to foresee all variables, grasp destiny in your own hands.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Gain crucial intelligence, seize battlefield initiative
choices.risk_hint: Too low Heavenly Fate may cause inaccurate foresight

text.content: The Tianji Record fragments materialized in Chen Ji's palm, golden characters writhing like living things. Image after image flooded his mind—Lin Yuan's traps, the dimensional rift's weaknesses, and... the location of Chen Nian.

choices.description: Walk a path no predecessors have taken, create a brand new path belonging to the Observer—yourself.
choices.risk_hint: Breaking conventions means possible loss of control

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled within Chen Ji: "Excellent! Master, you have finally taken this step! I will unseal the final page of the complete Tianji Record for you in advance!"

Three days later, the court assembly.

In the Golden Phoenix Hall, Chen Ji, in the Observer's black-gold robe, sat high beside the dragon throne. Below, all officials stood solemnly, their gazes carrying both reverence and anticipation.

"Esteemed ministers," Chen Ji's voice echoed through the hall, "In twenty-five days, I will engage in the final decisive battle with Lin Yuan at the Heavenly Secrets Mountains. This battle concerns the survival of all under heaven, the fate of the new order."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji slowly rose, his black-gold robe billowing in the morning wind. His gaze swept across the ministers, his voice loud and firm: "In twenty-five days, I will engage in the final decisive battle with Lin Yuan at the Heavenly Secrets Mountains. This battle—concerns the very survival of all under heaven!"

As his words fell, silence reigned in the Golden Phoenix Hall. Then, all officials cried out in unison: "Long live the Observer! Long live the new order!"

text.content:
The court assembly concluded. Chen Ji ascended alone to the highest point of the imperial capital—the Star-Picking Tower. This hundred-zhang tower was a symbol of the Observer's power, as well as the apex of the entire capital.

He stood atop the tower, gazing down at this city that had survived catastrophe. On the streets below, signs of life were returning; in the distant mountains, an unsealed dimensional rift hung like a狰狞的伤疤，悬浮在天际。

风吹拂过陈机的发梢，带来一丝凉意。他摊开手掌，天机录残页浮现其上。金色文字如活物般蠕动，一行从未见过的句子缓缓显现：

「第1095章 倒计时25日——观测者，你准备好了吗？」

陈机嘴角勾起一抹淡笑："准备好？从我得到你的那一刻起，我就一直在准备。"

天机录仿佛感应到了他的意志，金色文字骤然变化，化作一行新的预言：

「命运的棋盘已至终局。观测者陈机，你将以何种姿态，书写最后一页？」

陈机仰头望向那道狰狞的维度裂缝，眼中闪过一抹决然。二十五日——他已经等得太久了。
